titre: Having your own bank account after a separation
resume: Open an account in your name to receive child support and benefits and, if a bank refuses, use the right to an account through the IEDOM in Mamoudzou or the Banque de France: exact documents and timeframes.
aQuoiCaSert: After a separation, a personal account lets you receive child support and benefits from the CSSM (Caisse de sécurité sociale de Mayotte, Mayotte's social security fund), and pay the child's expenses while keeping clear records. If a bank refuses to open an account for you, a bank can be designated and will be required to do so, with free basic banking services. In Mayotte, the application can be filed with the Institut d'émission des départements d'outre-mer (IEDOM, the overseas central bank institute) or online with the Banque de France (the French central bank).
quiEstConcerne: A parent who has no account in their own name, or only a joint account with their ex-partner.
Anyone living in France who has no deposit account and has been refused an account.
Someone who holds only a joint account can also apply for the right to an account to get an individual account.
aSavoir: The bank has 15 days to reply to your account opening request. No reply means a refusal: the bank must then give you a refusal letter.
A bank is designated within 1 business day. This designation is valid for 6 months: contact the designated bank within that period.
The designated bank must open the account no later than 3 business days after receiving all the documents.

Free basic banking services: keeping and closing the account, a payment card, direct debits and transfers, deposits and withdrawals at the counter, 2 cashier's checks per month. Incident fees are capped at €4 per transaction and €20 per month.
In Mayotte, the IEDOM receives applications in Mamoudzou; online applications go through the Banque de France website.

documents.libelle: Proof of address less than 3 months old
documents.detail: Bill, rent receipt. If housed by someone: certificate of accommodation and your host's documents (to be confirmed with the bank).
Or, with no reply, proof of your request dated more than 15 days ago.

Bank details (RIB) of the new account
